data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104 reported a net release of GBP 22.6 million from prior year reserves in 2014. This favorable development was partly driven by reductions in loss estimates for older natural catastrophe events such as Hurricane Ike (2008), the Japanese earthquake (2011), and Thai floods (2011).
raw_causal_phrases: A release of GBP 22.6m from the net reserve for claims outstanding, set at 31 December 2013, has been made in calendar year 2014.
The old years' release of GBP 2m benefited from reductions in the loss estimates for Hurricane Ike, the Japanese earthquake and Thai floods.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is NET of reinsurance as no gross figure was available for the total movement. A partial gross release of GBP 2m for specific events was mentioned.
